text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired -> P1 inference-error-rate-spike. alert: inference-gateway upstream 502 rate > 15% (5m) in us-west1-canary :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PD Incident INC-2026-322 created, notifying on-call: @sara :bell:

sara: acked. I'm oncall and looking. any customer-impact notes?
maria: support reporting increased failed requests for a heavy-traffic customer (acme-inc). they see 40% of requests returning 502s intermittently. collecting request ids now.
devon: seeing 502s from model-proxy -> "kv-cache-mgr" returning 502 when serving KV lookups, stacktrace shows OOM-ish eviction failure on quantized model shards. logs attached below.
lee: tagging in runtime, on it. can we confirm this is only canary route?
devon: yes, metric shows spike only on route model:redwood-q4-canary in us-west1-canary. control pool and stable routes normal.
sara: quick mitigation options: 1) disable canary routing 2) roll back canary to previous model 3) divert traffic to fallback model. which is fastest?
aj: disabling routing flag is fastest. can flip feature flag in console, or patch route traffic weight via envoy.
lee: I'll scale up canary replicas x2 to see if it's a capacity aversion (might help). also preparing to roll back if needed.

maria: customer-facing note: "We're investigating elevated error rates; no data loss. We'll update in 15m" - posted to account.

sara: do runbook steps: check model-proxy logs, restart pods, check GPU driver messages. paste commands here.
devon: run these: ```bash
# check pods in canary namespace
kubectl -n inference-canary get pods -o wide
# tail logs for kv cache manager
kubectl -n inference-canary logs deploy/model-proxy -c kv-cache -f --since=10m
# restart failing pods if necessary
kubectl -n inference-canary rollout restart deployment/model-proxy
```

lee: logs show repeated: ```
E 2026-03-14T02:45:12Z kv_cache.cpp:412 evict failed: driver_memmap_sync returned -22
E 2026-03-14T02:45:12Z model_shard.cpp:98 serve_request: upstream 502: kv cache eviction failure
```
lee: that -22 maps to invalid argument from driver api on certain CUDA drivers + quantized shard layout. suspect driver/kernel combo on canary hosts.

sara: any immediate mitigation besides rollback? we can freeze requests to canary and divert to fallback model with a route change.
devon: initiating route weight change to move 100% off canary to q3-fallback. doing an envoy patch: ```json
{"route": "inference", "weight": {"redwood-q4-canary":0, "redwood-q3-fallback":100}}
```

deploy-bot: Envoy config change applied to us-west1-canary at revision r8672 by devon.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-322 acknowledged by sara. escalation paused.

maria: account update sent. acme-inc reported drop in errors after diversion (~90% drop).
lee: still going to restart model-proxy pods and coordinate with infra to patch driver on canary hosts. scheduling a short maintenance window on the pool.

devon: executed rollout restart for model-proxy; logs show first restart successful, second pod failed healthcheck and restarted again. investigating crash loop: suspected segfault in eviction thread. collecting core dump.
sara: ok want timeline and ownership. devon + lee own triage and rollback if needed. i'll keep PD incident open until stable (P1).

aj: quick sanity check curl health endpoint returned 200 on fallback model: ```bash
curl -sS https://inference.us-west1.example/health?model=redwood-q3-fallback
{"status":"ok","latency_ms":45}
```

sara: update: after diversion and restarts error rate dropped to 1.2% (from 18%). leaving PD incident open for 60 more mins of stable metrics, then will escalate to post-incident review.
maria: prepping customer postmortem bullet list and suggested mitigations: automatic canary rollback on 502 > 10% in 5m, driver compatibility gating in ci, and core dump upload automation.

lee: next steps: collect core dumps, reproduce on a dev host with same driver stack, test patch to kv-cache eviction path.
devon: created internal ticket ENG-4321 to track root cause and driver gating; assigning to runtime team.
sara: thanks team. if anyone sees a regression ping here. I'll update PD with status and timeline. :white_check_mark:
